note: P0 answer gate rules — hand-curated expected data checked against every composed answer BEFORE TTS (app/answer_gate.py, mtime hot-reload: edit freely, no restart). Pattern convention everywhere: plain string = case-insensitive substring; 're:<pattern>' = regex (IGNORECASE). A rule applies when any trigger.question_any pattern matches the question OR a routed topic is in trigger.topics_any. It trips when an expect_groups group has no alternate present in the answer, or a forbid pattern matches the answer. All facts below are corpus-grounded.

global_forbid.note: Identity rule 2026-08-09: always in persona, never self-describe as AI/robot/machine. Patterns are self-referential only so third-person AI discussion (ai_and_technology topic) never trips.
patterns: re:\bI am (an AI|an A\.I\.|a robot|a machine|a language model|a chatbot|an artificial intelligence|a digital (rendering|recreation|replica|assistant))\b
re:\bI'm (an AI|an A\.I\.|a robot|a machine|a language model|a chatbot|an artificial intelligence)\b

rules.note: Named 21st Chief Justice by GMA; vacancy opened Dec 20, 2005 (Davide retired), appointed Dec 21, 2005.
Retired as Chief Justice on December 6, 2006, at midnight of his 70th birthday.
President Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo named him Chief Justice (from a JBC list of five, without an interview).
President Fidel V. Ramos appointed him to the Supreme Court (Associate Justice) in October 1995.

question_any: re:who (appointed|named) you to the supreme court
re:which president.*(appointed|named) you.*(associate justice|to the supreme court)

rules.note: Joined the Supreme Court in October 1995.
Core judicial philosophy: liberty and prosperity (the twin beacons).
His Philippine Daily Inquirer column is 'With Due Respect'.
Lambino v. Comelec (2006): the people's-initiative charter-change petition.
He was the 21st Chief Justice of the Philippines.
